neighbours.label: the digit '0' completing the number 10 in a chapter reference (Matthew 10:28)
fire: Jesus sends out the twelve in Matthew 10:5, telling them where to go.
Paul writes in Romans 10:9 that whoever confesses will be saved.
The good shepherd passage in John 10:11 is read every spring.
See also 1 Samuel 10:1, where Saul is anointed as king.
In Luke 10:25 a lawyer asks Jesus what he must do.
The preacher quoted Hebrews 10:24 about encouraging one another.
We read Genesis 10 together, the table of nations.
As written in 1 Corinthians 10:13, no temptation is beyond us.
quiet: Jesus sends out the twelve in Matthew 11:5, telling them where to go.
Paul writes in Romans 12:9 that love must be sincere.
The good shepherd theme in John 14:11 is read every spring.
See also 1 Samuel 16:1, where David is chosen as king.
In Luke 15:25 the older brother returns from the field.
The preacher quoted Hebrews 12:24 about the new covenant.
We read Genesis 12 together, the call of Abraham.
As written in 1 Corinthians 13:13, love is the greatest.
